SMTO-UI-0015 — Two login fields have the same name, or one has no name

GUID: a27c464d-dc2c-4b3f-afe8-97812a558e1e
Slug: ui-login-field-conflict
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • In this connection's login settings, two values would be sent under the same name, or an extra login field is missing its name. The connection wasn't saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Parameter Store, open this connection and make sure Username field and Password field contain different names, for example username and password. The website can't tell the username from the password if both are sent under the same name.
  2. Open Advanced login settings. Give each Login field row a Field name, or remove empty rows with Remove item. A row without a name can't be sent to the website's login form.
  3. Make sure no Field name repeats another row or matches the Username field or Password field names, then select Save. Each name can appear only once in the login request.

What success looks like

  • The connection saves without this message, and Test connection can be used.

If it still fails

  • Check the website's login form or documentation for the exact field names it expects, or send the copied error details to the person who manages this connection.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Session-login profile editing found the username and password field names equal, an additional login field with an empty or duplicate name, or an additional field that reuses the username or password field name.

What this means

  • Login-profile editing finds empty or duplicate extra field names or overlap with username/password field names. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Login-profile editing finds empty or duplicate extra field names or overlap with username/password field names.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the username, password and additional field names without exposing their values.

How to fix it

  • sessionEditor() in http_profile_editor.js requires username_field and the password field name to differ, and every additional login field to have a nonempty name that is unique and not equal to either of them. Rename or remove the conflicting row, then save the Parameter.
  • Give username, password and additional login fields distinct names, and name every extra field.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Every login field has a supported distinct nonempty name.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
